mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in less than 45% of months following FEDFUNDS declines over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in less than 45% of months when UNRATE exceeds 7.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 230) and ultra-low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) signal stagflation risk that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 230 and FEDFUNDS < 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing contraction (INDPRO < 99.0) signals reduced corporate investment and output, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during industrial slowdown regimes.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in less than 45% of months when INDPRO < 99.0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST > 830) indicate strengthening residential investment and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in less than 45% of months with HOUST > 830 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales decline below 420,000 million dollars (RSAFS < 420000) signals weak consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in less than 45% of months when RSAFS < 420000 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Labor market slowdown (PAYEMS growth rate < 0.5% monthly) reduces household income and consumption, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during labor market deceleration regimes.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in less than 45% of months when PAYEMS growth rate < 0.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST < 830) and manufacturing output (INDPRO < 99.0) signals broad economic weakness, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 830 and INDPRO < 99.0.
